text_original: Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Long-term tester states the button-free key failed to open the car after a long day. Long-term tester states the electrochromic panoramic roof is glitchy and flickers when the car stops. Long-term tester states the Ultra's pixel headlights over-react to street lights, signs and other cars, flickering and adjusting constantly. Long-term tester states the automatic full beam does not work properly. Long-term tester states moving so many functions into the screen, even steering wheel adjustment, is almost always annoying. Long-term tester finds the car surprisingly efficient for its size and weight. Long-term tester states the seats are big and comfy. Long-term tester states the ventilated seats were a game-changer in a heatwave. Long-term tester states the high floor makes it hard to find the right driving position. Long-term tester describes rear visibility as appalling and front visibility as only okay. Long-term tester states the car is so large it does not fit in a parking space. Long-term tester rates the Bowers & Wilkins system as a fantastic upgrade. Long-term tester states the interior is still undeniably high quality. Long-term tester states the interior design feels colder and has less character than older Volvos. Long-term tester concludes that, with the roof, lights and key glitches, the car feels not yet fully developed. Original excerpt(s), from tool summaries: «that stupid, button-free key» «rarely anything other than annoying» «surprisingly efficient for such a big, heavy car» «completely and utterly massive» «It's incredible» «a generation before it's ready»
